reviews.evidence: Windows launcher covers service startup, autostart, lifecycle modes, prerequisite checks, logs, and redacted diagnostics; light/dark screenshots and concrete recovery steps are shown.
reviews.concern: The operational scope is intentionally narrow, and the README gives only one brief end-user scenario.

reviews.evidence: Ships a bounded file-memory protocol, validators, hooks, host init/read-only adapters, continuity sync, safe uninstall, and extensive host-specific operating and recovery guidance.
reviews.concern: Visible output evidence is mostly narrative; semantic discipline remains best-effort and limited to personal-scale, single-writer stores.

reviews.evidence: Provides an end-to-end local analytics workflow spanning connection, schema exploration, SQL execution, follow-up analysis, governance, charts, dashboards, and offline reports, with five concrete business scenarios.
reviews.concern: Security and compatibility are described well, but the README provides little test, troubleshooting, or failure-recovery evidence.

reviews.evidence: Comprehensive terminal agent with interactive and headless modes, persisted sessions, skills, hooks, lazy MCP, subagents, permissions, model routing, screenshots, benchmarks, and detailed command reference.
reviews.concern: Use cases are distributed across role and mode guidance rather than developed as full case studies with task outcomes.

reviews.evidence: Its own workflow searches the public topic catalog, filters and classifies candidates, compares matches, audits installation risks, requests consent, then installs and verifies the selection.
reviews.concern: The README shows no representative search result, comparison report, installation transcript, or troubleshooting path.

reviews.evidence: Bundles substantial novel and short-drama workflows, specialized roles, a three-pane workbench, live file navigation, review, and five explicit per-episode Markdown artifacts, demonstrated by two workflow GIFs.
reviews.concern: Beyond launching the two primary commands, operational guidance is sparse, and novel/short-drama scenarios are only briefly developed.

reviews.evidence: Unusually complete compatibility system with broad ABI mapping, lifecycle management, OAuth and UI bridging, detailed MCP walkthrough, many runnable scenarios, public verification tiers, tests, limitations, and failure handling.
reviews.concern: The bridge still documents four unavailable surfaces and lacks invocation of Pi plugin-drawn card renderers.

reviews.evidence: Covers multi-source anime discovery, paginated cards, resource details, torrent actions, optional streaming, configurable parsing and updates, with concrete prompts, screenshots, migration behavior, security limits, and troubleshooting.
reviews.concern: Explicit scenarios center on two search intents, and demonstrations do not show a full request-to-result interaction sequence.

reviews.evidence: Ready-to-run GUI/TUI distribution with shared sessions, workspace tools, customizable presets, host supervision, multiple model routes, extensive CLI operations, diagnostics, cache recovery, and two interface screenshots.
reviews.concern: It is explicitly a developer preview with changing upstream compatibility, and the README does not present concrete test results.

reviews.evidence: Exceptional office suite spanning sheets, docs, slides, bases, boards, Office import/export, isolated drafts, verification and review, with detailed request-to-output walkthroughs, screenshots, tools, limits, and tests.
reviews.concern: Current limits exclude slide masters and notes plus several advanced Board features and Board export.
